verdict.rationale: Elicit's core workflows act on many papers at once. Columns extract each data point across the whole paper set, and title/abstract and full-text screening run as automated steps over all gathered papers. Bulk RIS/BIB import, Zotero import, library and table export, Collections that launch reviews or extractions, and the API/MCP running a full systematic review programmatically add further batch operations. Missing for 10: explicit bulk management actions (multi-select tag, move or delete) on library items, documented scale limits for batch runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of large batch operations.
